description: This file defines the code-behind for the 'TheorySet' web page in the 'OnlineExamSystem' project. It handles UI events related to course and semester selection, adding questions, setting exams, and user logout. The code interacts with a SQL Server database to insert and retrieve data related to theory questions and course details.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: Partial class representing the code-behind for the TheorySet ASP.NET Web Forms page, managing course selection, question addition, exam setup, and user session management.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently contains commented-out code for session handling.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminLeaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on the selected semester.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Inserts a new theory question into the database, updates question number, and alerts the user.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Adds exam details for a selected course to the database.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to login page.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course list based on semester selection.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Sets the question number based on existing questions for the selected course.
